finding: Per-target diminishing ladder per control group (full, half, quarter, immune), read before each hit and advanced after it; reset 15 s after the last aura of the group ends. Defect: the 10 s PvP cap is declared (SpellMgr.cpp 2713 and SharedDefines.h 1674) but IsDiminishingReturnsGroupDurationLimited has no caller; reset uses wall time. Fix: wire the cap and use fixed-step ticks.

Stacking is split in two: a spell-group table (19 groups, 325 memberships; rules UNIQUE and UNIQUE_PER_CASTER) plus a per-aura-type switch. A DoT fixes its caster bonus at landing and re-reads the target bonus per tick. Fear and stun are independent flags with no priority between them.

Zul'Gurub soulflayer AI: one random hard control per mob (fear or knockdown), first control after 2-5 s, then every 8-10 s, timers paused while casting. The constructor does not set the CC pick, only JustRespawned does (possible defect D3, spawn order not verified).

Diminishing ladder per target and group: player type 1, 0.5, 0.25, immune; taunt on flagged creatures 1, 0.65, 0.4225, 0.274625, 0; PvP cap 10 s with per-family 6, 12, 40, 120 s values; reset 15 s after the last aura ends. Only player-owned casters move the ladder (mob chains never diminish, a design choice we reverse). Clock is wall time.

Control priority: stun over confuse over fear, one primary state shown; root locks the feet only with no stun up. A control hidden under a stun is re-resolved when the stun ends (the stun-to-fear hand-off). Keep this shape; the state bit is set on apply but the behaviour waits for the higher control, so the view should be computed from counts.

Stacking via a spell-group rule table (69 stack-rule rows, 5 rule values; 532 membership rows across 113 groups) inside Aura::CanStackWith. Stagger is only a boss spell name and timer in one encounter script (boss_northrend_beasts.cpp 34, 323); knockdown appears only as animation ids. Neither is a status in the read code; their effects live in spell data not read.
